note: OFF = the walk's own cold embed of the verbatim query, which the turn pays either way. ON = resolve() (cold, it fills the same _Q_CACHE key) + hints_line() + the walk's now-warm embed. ADDED is the difference and is what D10 budgets. ms_board_subject_ms is the resolver's OWN wall -- the production counter -- and is dominated by that shared embed. THE LANE SPLIT IS STATED AND NOT HIDDEN: these figures are a WALKING lane's. A lane that never walks (numbers_only, trivial) pays ms_board_subject_ms in full and nobody pays it back, which is what resolve(allow_embed=False) is for -- and which the orchestrator cannot decide at this call site, because the lane is plan_turn's own output (D10 addendum A1). The model load and the artifact load are once per process and sit outside every figure here: both are paid on a sentinel phrase first.
